title: Fully abstract game semantics for pure call-by-value
formal: Editorial effective arena-model variant: does the pure untyped call-by-value lambda calculus admit a compositional game interpretation satisfying the arena, effectiveness and interaction requirements below, whose equality of complete-play denotations is exactly termination-based contextual equivalence?
definitions:
Terms are x, lambda x.M and M N, modulo renaming bound variables. Values are variables or abstractions. Closed evaluation is weak left-to-right call by value: (lambda x.M)V reduces to the capture-avoiding substitution M[V/x], in evaluation contexts E::=hole | E M | V E; evaluation does not proceed inside an abstraction. A closed term terminates if it reaches an abstraction in finitely many steps. For terms M,N with free variables among x_1,…,x_k, contextual equivalence means that for every one-hole lambda term context C making both C[M] and C[N] closed, either both terminate or neither terminates. Contexts use only this pure syntax, with no store, control, parallelism or nondeterministic choice.

Selected model class: for each k, supply an arena A_k with a countable effectively coded move set, a decidable Opponent/Player and question/answer labelling, and a decidable enabling relation from an initial marker or earlier move. A finite play is a sequence with justification pointers to earlier enabling occurrences, with initial moves justified by the initial marker. Legal plays form a decidable prefix-closed set, alternate Opponent and Player starting with Opponent, and every answer closes the most recently unanswered question. Arena data depend on k, not on a particular term. A strategy is a prefix-closed set of legal plays, receptive to every legal Opponent extension, with at most one Player response to each history. A complete play has even length and no unanswered question. Denotation means the set of complete plays, with equality literal after a fixed effective coding of bound names, not a quotient by contextual equivalence.

The interpretation must uniformly enumerate the strategy for each finite term, provide fixed projection strategies for variables, and give uniform semantic abstraction and application operations on strategies with the appropriate free-variable interfaces. Each operation must be defined on strategies, not by recovering their source terms. Application must be realized by parallel interaction on matching call/return interfaces followed by hiding internal moves: formally give a decidable set of compatible finite joint plays, fixed projection maps to the component plays, and an external erasure map; the composite traces are exactly erasures of compatible joint plays whose component projections belong to the input strategies. Abstraction is a uniform interface relabelling with any required fixed call/return wrapper explicitly supplied. Prove associativity and identity for interaction, renaming compatibility, and the capture-avoiding substitution law for values.

Full abstraction requires, for every k and all such M,N, equality of their complete-play denotations iff contextual equivalence. All arena, enumeration and interaction algorithms must be ordinary computable algorithms without an oracle for termination or contextual equivalence. This fixes a concrete effective, alternating, well-bracketed trace variant of the broader request; it does not claim that every possible game-semantics formalism satisfies these restrictions.
answer_criterion: Construct the arena family and operations and prove every stated property, compositionality and full abstraction in Lean, or prove that no model in this explicitly selected class can satisfy them. A syntactic contextual quotient is not such a construction. A model fully abstract for contexts with mutable store does not automatically establish full abstraction for the pure contexts here.
context:
The research proposal identifies fully abstract game models for call by value as a research direction; it does not fix an admissible class of games. This card therefore labels its additional effective-arena restrictions as editorial.

The 2026 revision by Jaber and Sangiorgi relates operational games and process encodings, with its full-abstraction claim using contexts extended with store. That observation regime differs from the pure one retained here.
why: Full abstraction would align a structured semantic model exactly with observable program behavior.

import_provenance.original_title: Fully abstract game semantics for pure call-by-value
import_provenance.original_statement: Construct a compositional game model for the pure untyped call-by-value lambda calculus in which denotational equality coincides exactly with contextual equivalence, observed through termination in all closing contexts. This is the pure-calculus full-abstraction target in Faggian’s research programme, distinct from existing models for typed languages or languages extended with state and control.
